152.news_title: Widest Support for Arcade Games Boards on LCD Monitors
152.long_description: Get ready for V35 firmware updates on our range of custom arcade LCD monitors. Designed by arcade users for arcade machines, our plug and play arcade monitors are designed to work for most original arcade game boards offering the widest support on LCD monitors. From traditional 15khz arcade game boards through to 24 and 25khz game titles, as well as 31khz support, simply plug in your video wiring into our monitor, and press the auto adjust button to centre the image. Its this simple. No need for video converters, colour correctors, or adapters. Get ready for V35, with even more original arcade game board support (plus all your regular VGA, XGA, up to 4K support on various monitors). In our testing and photos, we demonstrate the following; ORIGINAL ARCADE GAME BOARDS - NBA Jam (Midway) - Outrun 2 SP (Sega) - Mario Kart 2 (Namco) - Time Crisis 4 (Namco) ARCOODA MONITORS ON DISPLAY - 35inch 4:3 aspect ratio LCD monitor - 32inch 16:9 aspect ration LCD monitor - 26inch 4:3 aspect ratio LCD monitor - 20inch 4:3 aspect ratio LCD monitor - 19inch 5:4 aspect ratio LCD monitor (used in the Arcooda Checkmate project) For more information about our monitor series please follow this link.
